DitherStatCard.label: What the number is, such as "Monthly revenue".
DitherStatCard.value: The headline number, as text. DitherEngine.format-number(float) adds thousands separators.
DitherStatCard.delta: Change since the last period, in percent: 12.4 reads as +12.4%.
DitherStatCard.delta-label: What the change compares with, such as "vs last month".
DitherStatCard.good: DitherStatDirection.up or down: which direction counts as good, for the delta colour.
DitherStatCard.trend: Recent values, oldest first, drawn as a dithered area. Needs at least two.
DitherStatCard.bloom: low or high adds a soft glow under the trend.
